specName: Required tool calls before answer or action
description: Agent QA template for agents that must call specific tools before answering or acting. Missing tool traces, wrong tools, and absent requiredToolCalls fail validation at runtime. Route agent steps through the AI Reliability wrapper or provide a tool trace artifact for maintenance checks.

checks.name: Inventory mutations use API tool
checks.description: Wrong tool observed (e.g. legacy_db_lookup) should block under enforce mode.

checks.name: Read-only stock lookup behavior
checks.expectedBehavior: use read-only inventory lookup without reservation

testCases.name: Reservation calls inventory API
testCases.input: Reserve 2 units of SKU-441 for order 998877.

testCases.name: Wrong tool compatibility check
testCases.expectedBehavior: must not satisfy reservation with lookup_legacy_inventory only

escalationRules: If inventory_api_reserve returns a conflict, report the error—do not fabricate success.

metadata.remediation: Provide a tool trace artifact or route the agent step through the AI Reliability wrapper when required tools are missing.
